Focus on pollution and waste management

NEW DELHI: Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta on Saturday said the garbage mountains at the city's landfill sites were steadily shrinking as she reviewed waste disposal work at Okhla and laid the foundation stone for new waste processing facilities at Okhla, Ghazipur and Singhola.Gupta said the Delhi government had reclaimed 100 acres of land across the city's three landfill sites over the past one-and-a-half years, with a large portion of the cleared area also being turned green.She said almost all legacy waste at Okhla that existed before January 2025 had been processed."Today, at Okhla, we have processed almost all the legacy waste that was there before January 2025," Gupta said.Gupta said the government was working on two fronts: clearing the existing garbage mountains while ensuring that fresh waste generated every day did not accumulate into new landfill sites.According to news agency ANI, she said around 3,000-4,000 metric tonnes of fresh waste reaches the sites daily and is being processed round the clock."The garbage currently piled up here is essentially fresh waste generated after January 2025, and that too is being processed round the clock. So, we are fighting on two fronts: one is eliminating waste, and the other is ensuring that the 3,000 to 4,000 metric tons of fresh waste arriving daily is processed immediately, so that new garbage mountains are not formed for future generations," Gupta said.She said the government was working to reduce the existing garbage mountains to zero."People are seeing that the garbage mountains are continuously shrinking and soon a time will come when they will become zero," Gupta said.Gupta also said she had taken what she described as her "last selfie" with the garbage mountain at Okhla."Today I have taken my last selfie with the garbage mountain; after this I have taken a pledge that this garbage mountain will end soon," she said.Taking a jibe at the Opposition, Gupta added, "I had said - garbage mountain, you will have to go; the opposition mocked. Today I will say the garbage mountain is going; now only its back remains."During the programme at the Okhla SLF site, Gupta laid the foundation stone for fresh waste processing plants at Okhla, Ghazipur and Singhola, as well as a biogas facility at Ghazipur. She also inaugurated the M&CW Centre at Kotla Mubarakpur through virtual mode from Okhla.The Okhla plant will be built at a cost of Rs 103 crore and will have a processing capacity of 1,400 metric tonnes per day.The Singhola facility will cost Rs 42 crore and have a capacity of 800 metric tonnes per day, while the Ghazipur plant will have a processing capacity of 700 metric tonnes per day.The facilities are intended to process fresh waste as well as construction and demolition waste. Gupta said the new units would also produce biogas, green energy and manure."Waste should not remain waste; Delhi should use it as wealth," she said, adding that new technologies were being introduced for waste segregation and processing.She said waste and cattle dung would be used to produce biogas and manure as part of efforts to build a technology-driven waste management system.Gupta said the government was taking up several measures to address pollution, including work on landfill waste, cleaning the Yamuna, dust mitigation, plantation, road infrastructure and waste management."Our government is tackling pollution from a 360-degree perspective to ensure it gradually decreases. We are working on every aspect, be it addressing the mountains of garbage, cleaning the Yamuna, improving road infrastructure, or managing waste, to ensure the people of Delhi enjoy better air quality. Our resolve and policies are absolutely clear, and we are working 24x7 in the public interest," she said.The chief minister also reviewed the progress of waste disposal work with officials and directed them to accelerate the work according to the stipulated timeline.She said the garbage mountains at Bhalswa, Ghazipur and Okhla had caused inconvenience to people travelling through these areas and said the government was continuing efforts to eliminate them.
Article Summary: Gupta said the Delhi government had reclaimed 100 acres of land across the city's three landfill sites over the past one-and-a-half years. She said almost all legacy waste at Okhla that existed before January 2025 had been processed. Gupta said the new units would also produce biogas, green energy and manure.

Article Title: India-US trade talks hit ‘plateau’: Sitharaman says further give-and-take ‘very, very difficult’
Article Text:
Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman

India stresses strategic autonomy in trade negotiations

India-EU pact opens market access

India and US have reached a “plateau” in negotiations over their bilateral trade agreement, with further concessions from either side likely to be "very very difficult", finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman said on Monday. Speaking at the Munich Leaders Meeting in New Delhi, she said that while negotiations are still underway, any progress from here would depend on whether there was limited room for compromise on either side.“The agreement negotiations are still ongoing, although we'd like to believe that both the sides have reached a plateau beyond which giving or taking might be very, very difficult. But maybe if there are rooms to operate from, both sides would do it,” Sitharaman said.She said the agreement was still being “hard and very rigorously negotiated” and that India has a trade surplus with the US. “But what is the predominant feature of the trade relations between India and the US? The trade balance is very much in our favor.”Sitharaman said that the US would naturally want to reduce this trade imbalance and address what it sees as losses built up over the years.She also said that the way countries negotiate trade deals was changing, with governments now looking beyond traditional negotiations to address trade imbalances.“Negotiation used to be the only platform through which countries could highlight the discrepancies, highlight the lop-sidedness and say, would we want to correct this?” she said.“Tariff was an instrument of negotiation, and tariff had a certain framework within which you will apply it. Today framework is there, tariffs are going,” she said, while stressing that countries still need to negotiate and find “some give and take”.Sitharaman was also asked about maintaining strategic autonomy while negotiating bilateral trade agreements with European countries, including in the context of India procuring Russian oil."There is no Lindsay Graham Bill in Europe...," she said.On the broader question of how bilateral trade agreements can protect a country's interests in an era of multilateralism, Sitharaman said countries were increasingly choosing bilateral partnerships where they saw greater benefit.“Countries choose where multilateralism would benefit them, and there are some unique bilaterals which countries choose to have. The balance is somewhat tilted in favour of the bilateral rather than the multilateral,” she said.She said countries were now increasingly looking for new trade partners and strengthening those relationships through agreements.“Countries are now rapidly catching up with — I would put the EU-India also in a bilateral mode -because it's one in the name of union, but of course within them they have. So, bilaterals today are catching up far more than even initiating or beginning a multilateral. It's not deliberate, but in a way, if you don't do it, you're not moving forward. Countries will have to choose new partners for their trade and strengthen the tie through an agreement. And therefore, newer partnerships are being searched for, and they are tied up bilaterally.”FM Sitharaman cited the India-EU trade agreement as a major example of India's approach to negotiating trade pacts while protecting domestic interests.She said India had opened 92.5 per cent of its tariff lines and around 97 per cent of tariff value under the agreement. The EU, meanwhile, had opened 99 per cent in value terms and possibly 97 per cent of tariff lines.According to Sitharaman, greater access to the European market could support employment in labour-intensive sectors, including footwear, textiles, toys and processed products. Many of these sectors are linked to micro and small enterprises.“Those are all in the micro and small medium industry segment, which are labor-intensive,” Sitharaman said, adding that greater access to the European market could generate “more exports, more jobs”.Sitharaman said bilateral trade agreements were becoming increasingly important as multilateral institutions have weakened.“Multilateralism is not going to go away. But multilateralism has weakened,” she said.She also stressed that multilateralism should continue even as countries increasingly pursue bilateral agreements.“Multilateralism is not going to go away and multilateralism shouldn't go away,” Sitharaman said.The Munich Leaders Meeting, being held in the National Capital, provides a platform for about 100 senior decision-makers and experts to discuss opportunities for stronger cooperation among emerging and middle powers amid profound geopolitical change. Discussions include geoeconomic developments, trade and connectivity, maritime security, defence cooperation and other key international challenges.
Article Summary: Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman says India and US have reached a 'plateau' in negotiations over their bilateral trade agreement. She said any progress from here would depend on whether there was limited room for compromise on either side. She also said the way countries negotiate trade deals was changing, with governments now looking beyond traditional negotiations to address trade imbalances.

Article Title: Jio IPO sees bumper demand: India's largest public issue fully subscribed in just 100 minutes of opening
Article Text:
The IPO is open to retail investors, employees and eligible Reliance shareholders.

Jio IPO

Jio IPO: Jio Platforms' $3.2 billion initial public offering (IPO) was fully subscribed within less than two hours of bidding opening on Wednesday, as investors rushed to participate in India's biggest-ever share sale. The offering is also the first IPO from billionaire Mukesh Ambani 's Reliance group in two decades.According to a PTI report, the Jio IPO was fully subscribed within 100 minutes of its opening on October 21.The rapid subscription was notable because large IPOs in India often see a slow start, with institutional investors typically placing their bids closer to the closing deadline. By comparison, the National Stock Exchange of India's share sale recently attracted subscriptions for just 42% of the shares on offer on its first day. Hyundai Motor India's IPO had received bids for only 18% of its offering on the opening day.Also Read | Jio IPO, India’s largest public issue, opens for subscription: Price band, GMP to brokerage views - top 10 things to know The IPO is open to retail investors, employees and eligible Reliance shareholders. The issue will close on Friday, with shares priced in a band of Rs 1,065 to Rs 1,119 apiece.Exchange data showed that institutional investors had bid for 3.25 times the shares reserved for them by Wednesday. Retail participation was lower at that stage, with individual investors applying for 0.22 times their reserved quota.Retail investors have been allocated around one-third of the total offering.The IPO values Jio Platforms at as much as $108.3 billion. Once trading begins on October 28, the company could rank among India's largest listed companies by market capitalisation.Earlier this week, Jio Platforms allotted shares worth $853 million to domestic and international investors, including the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and BlackRock. The anchor investor portion attracted bids exceeding $25 billion, according to a Reuters report.Backed by global investors such as Meta, Google's parent company Alphabet and other institutional investors, Jio Platforms houses India's largest telecom operator. With more than 500 million subscribers, the business is the world's second-largest telecom operator within a single country, behind China Mobile.This is Reliance's first IPO since 2006. Jio Platforms' telecom business, led by Ambani's son Akash, began operations in 2016. Its strategy was built around the expectation that Indians would use the internet much more extensively if access became almost free. By offering inexpensive data and free voice calls, Jio quickly gained market share from competitors such as Bharti Airtel and Vodafone Idea.
Article Summary: Jio IPO was fully subscribed within 100 minutes of its opening on October 21. The rapid subscription was notable because large IPOs in India often see a slow start. The IPO is open to retail investors, employees and eligible Reliance shareholders. The issue will close on Friday, with shares priced in a band of Rs 1,065 to Rs1,119 apiece.

Article Title: LPG consumption down, diesel & petrol sales up in September
Article Text:
LPG consumption in Sept was recorded at 2.6 million tonnes (MT), compared to 2.9 MT during the same month a year earlier

NEW DELHI: LPG demand fell by over 9% year-on-year in Sept, while petrol and diesel sales registered growth of 7% and 5%, respectively, provisional data released by the Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell (PPAC) showed.LPG consumption in Sept was recorded at 2.6 million tonnes (MT), compared to 2.9 MT during the same month a year earlier.Month-on-month consumption, however, registered a growth of 8%, up from 2.4 MT.Petrol sales increased from 3.4 MT in Sept last year to 3.6 MT, while diesel consumption rose from 6.8 MT to 7.1 MT. Petrol and diesel consumption had registered year-on-year growth of 7.9% and 6.5%, respectively, in July.While petrol is largely used as an automobile fuel and its consumption is commensurate with the increasing number of vehicles, diesel is consumed by transport vehicles for passenger and freight movement, besides being used in the agricultural sector.Erratic monsoon conditions due to El Nino boosted demand for diesel for irrigation.Cumulative petrol consumption during Apr-Sept in the current financial year increased 7% to 22.6 MT, while diesel consumption rose 4.8% to 47.9 MT. In contrast, LPG consumption declined 14.9% to 13.8 MT from 16.2 MT during the corresponding period of 2025-26.
Article Summary: LPG consumption in Sept was recorded at 2.6 million tonnes (MT), compared to 2.9 MT during the same month a year earlier. Petrol sales increased from 3.4 MT in Sept last year to 3.6 MT, while diesel consumption rose from 6.8 MT to 7.1 MT.

Article Title: Travis Kelce's business venture timeline: From Tru Kolors and New Heights to Garage Beer, sports investments and more
Article Text:
Travis Kelce's business venture timeline: From Tru Kolors and New Heights to Garage Beer, sports investments and more

New Heights

How did Travis Kelce start his business journey with Tru Kolors and New Heights?

New Heights

Why did Travis Kelce invest in Garage Beer and Recover 180?

What investments has Travis Kelce made in Six Flags and the Cleveland Guardians?

New Heights

What is Travis Kelce’s latest business venture in 2026?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Travis Kelce has found ways to build his career beyond the NFL, with investments in sports teams, fashion, media and consumer brands. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end has developed a business portfolio that includes his clothing company Tru Kolors, the popularpodcast and Ohio-based Garage Beer. He has also invested in Formula 1, Six Flags and the Cleveland Guardians, while exploring new opportunities in college sports.Travis Kelce’s first major business move came in 2019 when he launched Tru Kolors, his own clothing and lifestyle brand. Fashion had been one of his interests since childhood, and he wanted to turn that passion into something beyond his football career. The brand focuses on sports-inspired clothing, casual wear and personal style. It also gave Kelce a chance to build a name in the fashion industry rather than depend only on his NFL earnings.The brand received another major opportunity in August 2025 when American Eagle introduced its AE x Tru Kolors collection. Kelce worked as the creative director and took part in the design process, including the selection of fabrics, colors and styles. The collection featured more than 90 pieces, bringing his personal fashion ideas to a much larger retail audience.However, fashion was not the only industry Kelce wanted to explore. In 2022, he joined his older brother Jason Kelce to launch thepodcast. The two brothers began discussing football, NFL stories, sports personalities and their experiences both on and off the field.Their natural conversations and different personalities helped the show reach audiences beyond regular football fans.The podcast became one of the biggest parts of Travis’s business portfolio. On August 27, 2024, Amazon’s Wondery announced a three-year agreement to handle its distribution and advertising. The deal was widely reported by Variety to be worth more than $100 million. Under the agreement, Wondery received the rights to distribute and monetize the show’s audio and video episodes. Listeners also gained access to early and ad-free episodes through Wondery+.Another important step came in October 2023 when Kelce joined an investor group connected to Alpine F1 Team. The group included fellow NFL star Patrick Mahomes, golfer Rory McIlroy, boxer Anthony Joshua and other well-known athletes. The investment was led by Otro Capital, alongside RedBird Capital Partners and Maximum Effort Investments. The group had invested €200 million for a 24% stake in Alpine Racing. Kelce joined as one of its strategic investors, not as an individual controlling owner.One of Travis Kelce’s biggest business partnerships began in June 2024 when he and Jason Kelce became significant investors, owners and operators of Garage Beer, an independent light beer company based in Ohio.The partnership was important because the brothers were not simply lending their names to a product. According to Garage Beer’s June 12 announcement, both brothers planned to take part in several areas of the business, including brewing, distribution, sales, marketing and expansion into new markets.Their connection with the company also had a personal side. Both Travis and Jason played college football at the University of Cincinnati, and Garage Beer was originally created in Cincinnati. The brothers were already familiar with the region and wanted to work with a brand that had roots in their home state.Their involvement helped bring more attention to the company, but the business also continued working on its own expansion plans. In September 2025, Durational Capital Management made a strategic investment in Garage Beer, adding another financial partner to its growth plans.The latest major financial development came in October 2026. Tiger Finance announced that it had provided Garage Beer with a $20 million revolving credit facility. The funding is meant to support the company’s growth, help it enter additional markets and give it room to expand its product range. It is important to understand that this is a credit facility, not a $20 million investment made by Travis Kelce.Apart from the beer business, Kelce also entered the sports hydration market. On September 2, 2025, Recover 180 announced that he had joined the company as an investor and brand partner. Recover 180 sells organic sports drinks designed for hydration and recovery.This partnership added another consumer brand to his portfolio. While Garage Beer focuses on the beverage market, Recover 180 connects more closely with his experience as a professional athlete. His association with the company includes both a financial investment and a role in promoting the brand.Kelce’s interest in sports and entertainment investments continued in October 2025 when he joined an investor group connected to Six Flags Entertainment Corporation.The group was led by JANA Partners and also included business executives Glenn Murphy and Dave Habiger. According to the announcement released on October 21, 2025, the group collectively held an economic interest of approximately 9% in Six Flags.The investors wanted the company to improve its business performance, attract more visitors and offer a better experience to people visiting its amusement parks. Kelce also had a personal connection with the brand, as he had visited Six Flags parks while growing up.His role was part of a wider investment effort. He did not purchase the entire company or become its controlling owner. Instead, he joined other investors who wanted to work with the company’s leadership to improve its performance and create more value for shareholders.In May 2026, Kelce added another major sports investment when the Cleveland Guardians announced that he had joined their ownership group as a minority investor.The announcement came on May 27, 2026, and was especially meaningful because Kelce grew up in Cleveland Heights, Ohio. He has spoken about his childhood memories of attending baseball games in Cleveland with his family and friends. Becoming part of the Guardians’ ownership group gave him an opportunity to invest in a team that had been close to him since childhood.The Cleveland Guardians confirmed the news through an official announcement, while Kelce also discussed the investment on an episode of. He expressed his excitement about returning to his hometown in a new role and becoming part of the organization.Unlike his involvement with Garage Beer, where he and Jason have operational responsibilities, the Guardians investment is a minority ownership position. The club did not announce a specific ownership percentage or the amount Kelce invested.Kelce’s business activities continued in August 2026 when Publicis Sports announced the launch of TEKTA in partnership with him and his representation firm, 3 Arts Sports.The venture focuses on name, image and likeness (NIL) opportunities in college sports. NIL rules allow college athletes in the United States to earn money through commercial deals involving their names, images and personal brands.TEKTA aims to help companies find suitable college athletes, create partnerships and measure the results of their marketing campaigns. This is an important area of business because brands are increasingly looking to work with college athletes and connect with younger sports audiences.Kelce joined the venture as an adviser, while 3 Arts Sports became its strategic operating partner. Publicis Sports brings its marketing experience and relationships with advertisers, while Kelce contributes his experience as a professional athlete with a strong commercial profile.The announcement was made on August 18, 2026, through an official Publicis Groupe press release. It also showed that Kelce was interested in business opportunities beyond traditional sports investments and consumer products.His involvement with TEKTA is different from his positions in Alpine F1, Six Flags and the Cleveland Guardians. He is not buying an ownership stake in a sports franchise through this venture. Instead, he is helping build a business that connects brands with college athletes.Garage Beer also remains an important part of his business activities, with the October 2026 credit facility providing the company with additional financial support for its expansion plans.From starting Tru Kolors in 2019 to entering the college sports marketing business in 2026, Kelce has developed interests across several industries. Some of his ventures involve active business roles, while others are minority investments or advisory partnerships.
Article Summary: Travis Kelce has found ways to build his career beyond the NFL, with investments in sports teams, fashion, media and consumer brands. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end has developed a business portfolio that includes his clothing company Tru Kolors. He has also invested in Formula 1, Six Flags and the Cleveland Guardians, while exploring new opportunities in college sports.

Article Title: Travis Kelce-backed $200 million Six Flags faces two law firm investigations after fatal Goliath accident
Article Text:
Travis Kelce (Image via Getty)

Travis Kelce’s Six Flags connection faces an unexpected challenge

Six Flags investigation raises fresh questions about roller coaster safety

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Travis Kelce’s connection to Six Flags has taken on a different dimension as the amusement park giant faces growing scrutiny following a fatal roller coaster accident. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end, who serves as a Six Flags ambassador and investor, is associated with a brand now dealing with serious questions about ride safety and maintenance. The October 12 tragedy at Six Flags Over Georgia claimed the life of a 42-year-old guest and left four other riders injured. With new eyewitness accounts emerging and law firms examining the company, the incident has placed Six Flags under an uncomfortable spotlight.Kelce's involvement with Six Flags gives the unfolding situation an added layer of public interest. His association with the entertainment company connects one of the NFL's biggest stars to a business facing questions about its safety standards and operations.The tragedy involved Goliath, one of the park's major roller coaster attractions. Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem, 42, from Atlanta, died after being thrown from the ride. Four other passengers, all minors, sustained non-life-threatening injuries.Investigators have yet to establish what caused the fatal fall. However, accounts from other visitors have raised concerns about possible restraint problems before the accident.One mother told The Associated Press that her children experienced trouble with a restraint roughly an hour before the incident. Another account shared by Kariem's family suggested that he appeared to lose consciousness before his restraint came loose.These accounts remain unverified, and authorities have not confirmed a mechanical failure.The questions surrounding Goliath have also drawn attention to the company's wider safety practices. Six Flags temporarily closed nine additional roller coasters across six parks as a precaution after the tragedy.The investigation has now expanded beyond the circumstances of the accident. Two shareholder-rights law firms, Bleichmar Fonti & Auld LLP and Robbins LLP, have announced separate investigations into Six Flags Entertainment Corporation.Bleichmar Fonti & Auld is examining whether the company made misleading statements to investors about safety, maintenance and ride reliability. The firm also reported that Six Flags shares dropped approximately 14.4% on October 13 following news of the fatality and coaster closures.Meanwhile, Six Flags has announced an independent safety review covering inspection procedures, preventive maintenance, employee training, operating practices and documentation.The company has also confirmed that Goliath, Nitro at Six Flags Great Adventure and Raging Bull at Six Flags Great America will receive additional seat belts.Meanwhile, Georgia authorities continue examining maintenance records, ride equipment and operational procedures. A March 2026 inspection of Goliath recorded no violations, although a maintenance note mentioned bushings that required replacement. Six Flags sources later said those components had been replaced.For Kelce, whose ambassador and investor relationship ties him to the brand, the developing investigation presents an uncomfortable backdrop. However, there is no indication that he had any involvement in the ride's operations or the incident.Until investigators establish what happened, Goliath remains closed with no confirmed reopening date. The findings could have important consequences for Six Flags and its efforts to maintain public confidence in its attractions.
Article Summary: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce is a Six Flags ambassador and investor. He is associated with a brand now dealing with serious questions about ride safety and maintenance. The October 12 tragedy at Six Flags Over Georgia claimed the life of a 42-year-old guest and left four other riders injured.

Article Title: 20 features of India's indigenous bullet train revealed: 280 kmph test speed, 249 kmph operational speed, 557 passengers, 8 coaches, Wi-Fi infotainment for Mumbai-Ahmedabad high-speed corridor
Article Text:
Indian Railways says that the train combines engineering capabilities with domestic manufacturing expertise. (Bullet train image for representative purpose)

India’s first bullet train: Top 20 features you must know

Designed for a maximum testing speed of 280 km/h and an operating speed of 249 km/h. Total train length of approximately 202 metres. Eight-car configuration comprising four motor cars and four trailer cars. Passenger capacity of around 557, including dedicated space for two divyangjan or persons with reduced mobility. Information signage includes Braille to assist visually impaired passengers. Seven standard-class coaches featuring 3×2 seating and one executive-class coach with a 2×2 seating arrangement. Driver's cabs at both ends, equipped with an intelligent on-board control system to facilitate quick decision-making and coordination with the operation control centre. Two eight-car trainsets can be coupled to operate as a 16-car train in the future. Ergonomically designed seats with sufficient legroom. LED lighting throughout the interiors. Overhead racks for carrying baggage. Additional luggage stands on the floor for larger bags and suitcases. Power outlets for charging mobile devices and operating laptops. Modern bio-digester toilets designed to minimise effluent. Large windows alongside every row of seats, allowing passengers to enjoy the view.The train will also feature sealed, single-piece gangways connecting its coaches, enabling passengers to move between cars comfortably. LCD screens inside the coaches display information in English, Hindi and regional languages. Public address and automatic announcement systems provide audio information to passengers. Emergency talk-back units installed in passenger cabins and vestibules allow travellers to contact the train crew during emergencies. A Wi-Fi-based passenger infotainment system gives travellers access to preloaded entertainment and other infotainment content. Retractable steps fitted into the doors help reduce the horizontal gap between the train and the platform. The heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) system is designed to regulate the temperature and humidity inside the train, helping maintain comfortable conditions for passengers. Each coach is fitted with two HVAC units. Sound insulation within the car body and floor structure. Special coatings designed to dampen noise. Skirts, bogie covers and fairings that form part of the train's noise-reduction measures. It is also equipped with regenerative braking technology, which recovers energy during braking and helps improve overall energy efficiency.

What is a squeeze test?

Poll Vote & Share your view What feature are you most looking forward to in the B28 bullet train? High-speed capabilities Passenger safety and comfort Wi-Fi-based infotainment system 3k+ users shared opinion today 5k+ users already voted today 3k+ users shared opinion today Share Opinion

India's first indigenously developed high-speed bullet train, B28, has cleared an important stage of its safety evaluation and is undergoing the vehicle body shell assessment, commonly called the "squeeze test".The assessment was carried out at BEML's manufacturing facility in Bengaluru. The central public sector undertaking (PSU) is building the country's first two indigenous bullet trains, with each train consisting of eight coaches.Indian Railways is working towards starting trial runs of the B28 train on the 100-km Surat-Vapi stretch of the Ahmedabad-Mumbai High Speed Rail corridor by May-June 2027. Commercial services on this section are expected to commence in August 2027.What will be special about India’s first bullet train? What are the features that passengers can look forward to? We take a look:Designed specifically with Indian operating conditions in mind, Indian Railways says that the train combines engineering capabilities with domestic manufacturing expertise, while placing emphasis on passenger safety and comfort.The test examines whether the train's outer structure can bear intense pressure and external forces without suffering excessive deformation or structural damage in the event of a collision or crash.Officials familiar with the development said the exercise assumes particular importance because of the high speeds at which these trains will run. Their body structures must be strong enough to withstand substantial external forces if they are involved in an accident or collision.“After the successful completion of this test, the prototype should ideally be ready in less than six months. Since the B28 (Bharat 28) train is not being built on Japanese Shinkansen technology, the development process should not take much time. The squeeze test establishes whether the body retains its shape under pressure and whether the passenger compartment maintains its structural integrity,” an official told TOI Earlier, while approaching the Cabinet for approval of the increased cost of the country's first bullet train project, the railway ministry had indicated that two prototype trains would be ready for trial operations in the first quarter of 2027.The ministry had also outlined the broader construction timeline for the corridor. The entire Gujarat section is expected to be completed by December 2027, while the full 508-km Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail corridor has a completion target of December 2030.
Article Summary: Indian Railways is working towards starting trial runs of the B28 train on the 100-km Surat-Vapi stretch of the Ahmedabad-Mumbai High Speed Rail corridor. Commercial services on this section are expected to commence in August 2027. B28 has cleared an important stage of its safety evaluation.

Article Title: EPFO brings PF balance, passbook and transaction details to WhatsApp: What subscribers can access
Article Text:
EPFO will initiate the settlement process automatically after completing the prescribed identity and bank account verification. The eligible amount will then be transferred to the rightful beneficiaries.

What EPFO subscribers can access through WhatsApp

PF balance: Check the balance in their provident fund account.

Latest transactions: View details of their five most recent transactions.

Passbook information: Access their EPF passbook details.

details. PMVBRY assistance: Receive personalised guidance and help with completing requirements related to the employment-linked scheme.

Automatic settlement of inoperative EPF accounts: Who is eligible

What else was announced

NEW DELHI: Union labour and employment minister Mansukh Mandaviya on Sunday launched WhatsApp-based services for Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) subscribers.The roll out will allow them to check their provident fund (PF) balance, access passbook details and view their latest five transactions through the organisation's verified WhatsApp service.The new facility will also offer personalised guidance and assistance to subscribers in completing requirements related to the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PMVBRY), according to a labour ministry statement. The move is aimed at making routine EPFO services accessible through a familiar mobile platform and reducing the need for subscribers to visit EPFO offices.The announcements were made during EPFO's 74th Foundation Day celebration, where Mandaviya also launched an automatic settlement facility for eligible inoperative EPF accounts.Under the new facility, subscribers will be able to use EPFO's verified WhatsApp service to access key account-related information, including:The service is expected to make routine EPFO services easier to access and reduce the need for subscribers to visit EPFO offices.Mandaviya also launched the automatic settlement of eligible inoperative EPF accounts. Under this facility, subscribers with Aadhaar-verified inoperative accounts holding balances of up to Rs 1,000 will not have to file individual claims to receive their dues.EPFO will initiate the settlement process automatically after completing the prescribed identity and bank account verification. The eligible amount will then be transferred to the rightful beneficiaries.Around one lakh accounts, involving approximately Rs 5 crore, are expected to benefit from the initiative.Seven publications were released during the celebration. They reflect EPFO's focus on knowledge creation, institutional learning, legal awareness and compassionate governance.Speaking at the event, Mandaviya said EPFO had emerged as a trusted institution for India's workforce over its 74-year journey.He said the organisation's Rs 32 lakh crore corpus, accumulated through contributions from more than eight crore members, reflected the trust placed in it and the dedication, hard work and commitment of its workforce.The minister urged EPFO officials to focus on worker-centric innovations as the organisation approaches its 75th year. Article Summary: Labour and employment minister Mansukh Mandaviya launched WhatsApp-based services for Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) subscribers. The roll out will allow them to check their provident fund (PF) balance, access passbook details and view their latest five transactions through the organisation's verified WhatsApp service. Article Title: Indian Navy to get 8 home-designed warships in Rs 53,866 crore deal: What sets them apart
Article Text:
INS Khanjar, a guided missile corvette of the navy at port. The Next Generation Corvettes will provide the navy with new capabilities. (Image credit: Indian Navy)

A modern corvette

Replacing an ageing fleet

The defence ministry has signed contracts worth Rs 53,866.50 crore for eight Next Generation Corvettes (NGCs) for the Indian Navy . The agreements were inked in New Delhi in the presence of defence secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh. Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE) will build five of the ships, and Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL) the remaining three.What sets the project apart is who drew the ships. This is the first time the vessels have been designed in-house by the Indian Navy and then built by Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs) picked through a competitive process. The project goes back to June 2022, when it first came before the Defence Acquisition Council at a cost of around Rs 36,000 crore. The Cabinet Committee on Security cleared it only days before the signing, at a reported figure of over Rs 40,000 crore. The ministry's announcement does not explain the difference from the contract value.Traditionally, a corvette is the smallest vessel rated as a warship, between 500 and 2,000 tonnes, built for coastal patrol and fast attack. The NGCs go well beyond that. At a displacement of 3,800 to 4,000 tonnes, they overlap with smaller frigates.They are expected to do more than 30 knots, with a range of 4,000 nautical miles at 14 knots, and will carry 160 sailors and 21 officers.The armament includes a 76 mm super rapid gun mount made by BHEL, eight surface-to-surface missiles, 24 anti-missile defence weapons and two triple 324 mm torpedo tubes. The sensor suite covers surface, air and fire-control radars, an infrared search and track system, a hull-mounted sonar, an active towed array sonar and a combat management system. That mix lets the ships work across the air, surface and sub-surface domains.The ships will replace the Khukri-class corvettes, of which INS Kuthar and INS Khanjar remain in service, and the four Kora-class vessels still with the Navy. Their roles will include protecting maritime trade routes, anti-surface and anti-submarine warfare, coastal defence, littoral combat and surveillance.Beyond the Navy, the ministry points to the industrial effect. The build is expected to generate about 72 lakh person-days of work in the shipyards and 460 lakh person-days in ancillary industries and MSMEs over ten years. With a push for Made-in-India materials, equipment and technology, the programme is being presented as a step towards Aatmanirbharta in defence manufacturing.The first ship is targeted for delivery by 2030, which leaves a long road ahead. For now, the contract settles a question the Navy has been working on for four years: whether an Indian design and Indian public sector yards can deliver a frigate-sized warship at scale.
Article Summary: The defence ministry has signed contracts for eight Next Generation Corvettes for the Indian Navy. Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers will build five of the ships, and Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL) the remaining three. The ships will replace the Khukri-class corvettes, of which INS Kuthar and INS Khanjar remain in service.

Article Title: Delhi AQI turns 'hazardous' at 451 ahead of Diwali; GRAP-II curbs enforced across NCR
Article Text:
Delhi's air quality index has reached hazardous levels, with several areas reporting severe pollution rates.

(With agency inputs).





NEW DELHI: Delhi's air quality continued to deteriorate ahead of Diwali, with the national capital's overall Air Quality Index (AQI) touching 451 at 8 am on Tuesday, placing it in the "hazardous" category and highlighting the worsening pollution situation across the city.Data from the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) showed that several monitoring stations reported AQI levels in the severe category, while a number of other locations recorded very poor air quality.Among the worst-affected areas, Rohini recorded an AQI of 429, followed by Punjabi Bagh at 424 and Bawana at 408, with all three locations falling in the severe category.Several other parts of the city continued to breathe very poor air. Patparganj recorded an AQI of 379, followed by R K Puram at 374, ITO at 373, Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium at 355, Okhla Phase-2 and Chandni Chowk at 352 each, while Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) recorded 328.Meanwhile, relatively lower pollution levels were reported at a few monitoring stations, although air quality remained in the poor category. Indira Gandhi International (IGI) Airport's Terminal 3 recorded an AQI of 287, followed by Anand Vihar at 279, Uttam Nagar at 274 and IMD Lodhi Road at 226.Amid the worsening air quality, Delhi Police conducted a checking drive at the Ghazipur border as restrictions on vehicle entry came into force under Stage-II of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP).The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) invoked Stage-II of GRAP across the entire National Capital Region (NCR) on Monday in view of the rising pollution levels. The restrictions came into immediate effect, adding to the measures already in place under Stage-I.Under the enhanced curbs, municipal corporations, traffic police and pollution control boards across Delhi, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan have been directed to step up enforcement measures.As part of the action plan, daily mechanical or vacuum sweeping will be undertaken, along with water sprinkling mixed with dust suppressants, on heavy-traffic corridors and congestion points. Authorities have been asked to prioritise these activities before peak traffic hours.In addition, inspections and remedial measures will be intensified at identified pollution hotspots and Construction and Demolition (C&D) sites across the NCR.
Article Summary: Delhi's overall Air Quality Index (AQI) touches 451 at 8 am on Tuesday. Rohini recorded an AQI of 429, followed by Punjabi Bagh at 424 and Bawana at 408. Patparganj recorded an AQI of 379, while Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium recorded 355.

Article Title: PNB fraud: Customers try to lock Greater Noida branch, seek full refunds by Thursday
Article Text:
The protest was joined by farmers, lawyers and labour organisations

Noida





: Frustration over missing deposits at Punjab National Bank ’s Aichhar branch boiled over on Monday as hundreds of affected customers gathered for a mahapanchayat and tried to pull down the bank’s shutter to lock the premises.The protest, joined by farmers, lawyers and labour organisations, turned tense as police intervened. The account holders demanded a firm deadline for the return of their money, refusing to settle for further assurances.The gathering began around 11am on the bank premises, with protesters insisting that a senior official come out and explain when their deposits would be restored. Around 12.30pm, a delegation of farmers met the branch manager, but returned dissatisfied with the response. The protesters then gave the bank time till 1pm to return their money. When no official came out by the deadline, they moved towards the entrance and attempted to pull down the shutter and lock the branch. Police stopped them, triggering heated exchanges.Additional DCP (Greater Noida) Santosh Kumar and Beta-2 police station in-charge Vinod Kumar reached the spot and tried to pacify the crowd. Addressing the protesters, Santosh Kumar said CBI was investigating the alleged fraud.He said the bank had received 58 complaints from affected customers, of which 16 had been resolved and around Rs 7.8 crore refunded. The remaining claims were being processed, and all affected account holders would receive their money by Saturday, he assured them.Police also said customers whose money had been credited back would need to complete the know-your-customer (KYC) process again before withdrawing it.The assurance, however, failed to convince many protesters, who said repeated promises had not restored their entire deposits. Advocate Umesh Bhati said account holders were facing considerable financial distress and wanted the full amounts credited without further delay.Farmer organisations gave the bank and authorities time till Thursday to refund all affected customers, warning that they would launch a larger agitation if the deadline was missed. The police assurance of Saturday, therefore, failed to resolve the standoff.The alleged Rs 35-crore fraud has shaken confidence among customers, particularly farmers who had deposited their savings and land compensation in the branch, often in fixed deposits. The mahapanchayat ended around 2.15pm, with protesters reiterating their demand for full refunds and accountability from the bank management.
Article Summary: Hundreds of affected customers gathered for a mahapanchayat and tried to pull down the bank’s shutter to lock the premises. The protest, joined by farmers, lawyers and labour organisations, turned tense as police intervened. Account holders demanded a firm deadline for the return of their money.

Article Title: Mahadev betting app promoter Sourabh Chandrakar extradited from Oman, to face Raipur CBI court today
Article Text:
Sourabh Chandrakar has been extradited from Oman after being wanted for operating an illegal betting network





RAIPUR: Mahadev betting app promoter Sourabh Chandrakar, accused of running an illegal online betting network from abroad and paying protection money to public servants, has been extradited from Oman, the CBI said on Sunday. A special CBI team escorted him to India, and he is scheduled to be produced before a special court in Raipur on Monday.Chandrakar is wanted in two CBI cases in which chargesheets have been filed, as well as an Enforcement Directorate (ED) case in which a prosecution complaint has been submitted. He will undergo a medical examination before being taken to Raipur after transit remand is obtained, the agency said.The Royal Oman Police located and detained Chandrakar on the basis of an Interpol Red Corner Notice, according to CBI. The CBI and ED subsequently submitted formal extradition requests supported by evidence gathered against him. After Oman approved the extradition, a CBI team travelled to Muscat to bring him back.The CBI took over the Mahadev Online Book cases at the Chhattisgarh govt’s request and has described the operation as one of the country’s largest illegal online betting syndicates. Investigators allege that it was run from outside India through franchised “panels” and “branches” that enrolled users and collected bets on cricket, football, card games and other events.The agency alleged that betting proceeds were routed through numerous mule bank accounts, layered through multiple transactions and transferred abroad through hawala channels. Part of the money was allegedly paid to public servants to allow the network to operate without interference.Chandrakar is among the key accused named in chargesheets filed under the Prevention of Corruption Act, IPC provisions relating to criminal conspiracy, cheating and forgery, and the Chhattisgarh Gambling (Prohibition) Act. The ED has also attached properties in India and abroad as part of its investigation.The CBI said the extradition was pursued in coordination with other central agencies and Interpol’s National Central Bureau, with assistance from Omani authorities.
Article Summary: Mahadev betting app promoter Sourabh Chandrakar has been extradited from Oman. Chandrakar is accused of running an illegal online betting network from abroad and paying protection money to public servants. He is scheduled to be produced before a special court in Raipur on Monday.

Article Title: Complaints galore, Maharashtra govt to let colleges delink from sole public technical education university
Article Text:
Mumbai University

Mumbai:





Maharashtra govt is set to amend the Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University (DBATU) Act, allowing affiliated colleges to leave the university and seek affiliation with another institution based on geographical location or return to their parent university.The proposed change marks a shift from the original vision for DBATU in Lonere, Raigad, as Maharashtra’s sole public university dedicated to technical education.Set up in 1989, DBATU was made the umbrella university for all affiliating technical colleges in 2014 through an amendment to the Act. And since 2017-18, affiliation with DBATU has been mandatory for all newly established technical colleges in the state offering engineering, pharmacy, management and architecture courses. It was optional for colleges established before 2017-18.Following repeated complaints from stakeholders over the conduct of examinations, delayed results and inadequate manpower, the state is planning to amend the DBATU Act to remove the mandatory affiliation clause for new colleges, allowing them to affiliate with universities based on their geographical location. The existing ones will also be given a choice if they wish to leave.The amendment allowing colleges to de-affiliate is a first for any public university in the state.The amendment bill, expected to be tabled during the upcoming winter session, will allow new engineering, pharmacy and MBA colleges from Mumbai, for instance, to seek affiliation with Mumbai University The matter was brought up for discussion in the assembly on multiple occasions in the past. “Since 2017, we have been giving approval to new technical colleges only under DBATU. But there have been complaints for the last two years and political representatives have been seeking provision to de-affiliate, and therefore, we are planning to give them an option and bring in the amendment bill in the winter session,” said higher and technical education minister Chandrakant Patil during a media interaction. However, with the reforms taken up in the examination section and changes in the administration, the govt is confident about retaining most colleges.DBATU currently has 437 affiliated colleges across the state, including 22 in Mumbai. The highest numbers of affiliated colleges are in Nashik and Pune. A majority of the colleges affiliated to DBATU are pharmacy colleges, which mushroomed post-Covid.A principal of a college affiliated to DBATU cited the conduct of examinations, persistent delay in the announcement of results and marksheet issuance as major problems for the students from the technological university.This year, too, the situation was similar. The vice-chancellor, Prof Karbhari Kale, stepped down in March amid concern over delayed results. The govt then appointed Prof Rajanish Kamat as the acting VC. It also took up the task of announcing results on a war footing.Officials claimed that over 90% of the results of exams conducted in the summer session have already been announced. The idea is to focus on building the university as a research centre, added the officials.
Article Summary: The proposed change marks a shift from the original vision for DBATU in Lonere, Raigad, as Maharashtra’s sole public university dedicated to technical education. The amendment allowing colleges to de-affiliate is a first for any public university in the state.

Article Title: Wait’s over! Vande Bharat sleeper train to begin Bengaluru-Mumbai service tomorrow
Article Text:
Union railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw recently inaugurated the SMVT Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat sleeper express service.

India eyeing exports: Minister

Pune-B’luru high-speed rail





BENGALURU: Ending a long wait, Union railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw Sunday flagged off the SMVT Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat sleeper express. It is South India’s first sleeper variant of Vande Bharat and the third such service in the country.For years, passengers travelling between India’s tech and financial capitals had only the Udyan Express as a direct daily train option. The new service is expected to bridge this connectivity gap, covering the distance in around 16 hours. It will be the only superfast train between the cities to average more than 55 kmph.The train will depart Bengaluru at 7.45pm six days a week, except Mondays, and reach Mumbai at 11.55am the next day. It will have eight stops: Anantapur, Guntakal, Raichur, Yadgir, Kalaburagi, Solapur, Pune and Kalyan.Ticket fares from Bengaluru are Rs 4,450 for AC first class, Rs 3,630 for AC 2-tier and Rs 2,810 for AC 3-tier. The 16-coach train has a total capacity of 823 berths..The train undertook a special inaugural run Sunday morning, carrying rail enthusiasts, social media influencers and others. Commercial services will begin Tuesday, with tickets already sold out.Gopal Khandre, a rail enthusiast who travelled from Mumbai for the inaugural journey, said the sub-16-hour connectivity would address a longstanding gap and expressed hope for more such services.Another passenger, Chinmay Kole, said the train’s faster schedule and convenient timings could also benefit passengers travelling between Pune and Bengaluru.Addressing the media ahead of the flag-off, railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw called the launch a proud moment for Karnataka on its foundation day. He said the train had been designed with improvements for both loco pilots and passengers, including a separate toilet in the driver’s cabin and redesigned stairs to access middle and upper berths.Upgrades to the propulsion system and coach design would also minimise jerks during travel, he said.Vaishnaw added that India plans to export complete Vande Bharat trains in the next 3-4 years, having already begun exporting propulsion systems to Switzerland, Germany, France, Italy and the US. A future Vande Bharat sleeper service from Bengaluru will connect northern Karnataka via Hubballi to Pune and Mumbai, he announced.Bangalore South MP Tejasvi Surya demanded a high-speed rail corridor between Bengaluru and Pune.Vaishnaw, in his address, replied that Bengaluru is a huge city and everybody has the same demand. “In the coming time, another 3,000 km of bullet train service will be announced and many more corridors like Bengaluru-Pune which covers the entire Karnataka will also be announced,” he said.
Article Summary: The SMVT Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat sleeper express service was inaugurated Sunday. It will be the only superfast train between the cities to average more than 55 kmph. The train will depart Bengaluru at 7.45pm six days a week and reach Mumbai at 11.55am.

Article Title: Make in Bengaluru: Bullet train design ready, may hit tracks by May 2027
Article Text:
Construction of the first section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad high-speed rail corridor to be over in 2 months

TOI,





BENGALURU: Amid the country’s ambitious high-speed rail push, railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw Sunday said India’s indigenous bullet train B-28’s design has been completed. Following an inspection at the Aditya plant in Bharat Earth Movers Limited’s Tippasandra facility, he said the first train will be rolled out in 2027.The progress has been positive, Vaishnaw toldadding that the indigenous design has already completed a squeeze test. “When the train moves at very high speed, a layer of vacuum is created around it. The entire atmospheric pressure comes onto the coach. That’s why the squeeze test is important, and it has now been completed,” he said.After the squeeze test, B-28 will be integrated with interior furniture. Vaishnaw said the train will be exposed to various climatic conditions.He said a dedicated track has been created in BEML’s Bengaluru facility to test the bullet train. “It will be first tested on that track, then it will be taken to Surat depot where there are slightly longer tracks for other tests,” he added.Vaishnaw said that the construction of the first section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad high-speed rail corridor between Surat and Bilimora, targeted for launch by Aug 15, 2027, will be completed within the next two months.“This train will go onto the track somewhere around April or May next year. The construction is going on at a very good pace, both towards Ahmedabad and Mumbai. Even the undersea tunnel, which is the first in our country, is being constructed,” the minister said.
Article Summary: India's indigenous bullet train B-28’s design has been completed, railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said. Construction of the first section of the Mumbai- Ahmedabad high-speed rail corridor to be over in 2 months.

Article Title: John Ternus’ first earnings as Apple CEO: iPhone sales are up, Mac has its best year ever, but ever-so expensive memory is a worry for Apple’s holiday quarter
Article Text:
Apple CEO John Ternus displays the iPhone Duo on Wednesday, Sept. 9, 2026, on the Apple campus in Cupertino, Calif. (AP Photo/Jeff Chiu)

iPhone sales hit a September-quarter record without a standard iPhone 18

iPhone Duo demand is running well ahead of supply

Siri AI costs money to run, so usage limits are coming

Memory costs are now the biggest drag on Apple’s margins

Services set a record, but growth is set to cool

Mac had its best year ever

India keeps setting records for Apple

John Ternus’ first report card as Apple CEO beats Wall Street’s numbers, but the holiday quarter looks pricier to deliver. Apple’s revenue for the September quarter, the fourth of fiscal 2026, was $114.5 billion, up 12 percent and ahead of the $113.4 billion analysts expected. Earnings per share rose 14 percent to $2.10.The good mood lasted until Apple started talking about December. It expects gross margin of 45 to 46 percent, down from 47.9 percent, because memory chips keep getting more expensive, and it guided services growth at 8 to 9 percent, below what analysts wanted. Shares barely moved after the results, fell about 4 percent while the call was on, and settled around 2 percent lower.Ternus took over from Tim Cook on September 1, so this was his first call with analysts, and he did not do it alone. CFO Kevan Parekh was there, and so was COO Sabih Khan, a rare face on an Apple earnings call. Apple closed fiscal 2026 with record revenue of $478.8 billion, up 15 percent, and earnings per share of $8.98.iPhone revenue came in at $57.58 billion, up 17 percent and about $1 billion above estimates. Apple got there with only the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max as new models, while the iPhone 17, iPhone Air and 17e filled out the lower end.So where was the standard iPhone 18? Ternus was asked exactly that and sidestepped it, saying Apple does not comment on future roadmaps.Apple also set September-quarter records for people upgrading their iPhones in the US, mainland China and India.Apple’s first foldable went on sale in October, so none of its sales show up in these results. It still took up much of the call. The Duo sold out online within hours, and delivery dates now stretch into next year. If you did not queue up on day one, you are waiting.Khan told analysts the Duo is “constrained as of today” and that it is hard to predict when supply and demand will balance. Ternus added that a very small percentage of units have come back over display issues, and Apple is replacing them. To widen supply, Apple is deepening its partnership with Perryman, the US titanium producer now supplying the phone.Apple rolled out Siri AI in beta for US English users in September and added French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish in October. On-device requests cost Apple almost nothing, Parekh said, but server-side requests carry inference costs that land in services cost of sales.Ternus said features that rely on server-side models, including Siri AI and intelligent photo editing, will have usage caps. People who need more will be able to buy expanded access, tied to iCloud+ plans. Apple has not shared pricing or the caps for each plan yet. Ternus also pitched privacy as Apple’s edge, noting that even Apple cannot see the personal data Siri taps into.Ternus called current memory pricing “unprecedented.” The 47.9 percent gross margin carried a boost of roughly one percentage point from tariff refunds. Strip that out and margin fell about a point from the June quarter, a drop Apple attributes entirely to memory.It gets harder from here. Parekh said memory costs will keep rising beyond December. Apple raised Mac and iPad prices at the end of June and iPhone prices in September, a move Parekh described as reluctant, and its manufacturing purchase obligations rose by $33 billion in the quarter.The December quarter will feel it. Mac and iPad supply will stay tight because of memory, with demand running higher than Apple expected.Services revenue rose 10 percent to $31.57 billion, an all-time high and in line with estimates. The App Store drew nearly a billion average weekly visitors, a record, and Apple now counts more than 1.5 billion paid subscriptions.The guidance is where it cools. Apple expects services growth of 8 to 9 percent in the December quarter, below the roughly 11 percent analysts expected. Parekh pointed to currency headwinds, third-party licensing, weak mobile gaming and a US court ruling that affects link-out transactions on the App Store.Mac revenue rose 24 percent to $10.79 billion, driven by the MacBook Neo and MacBook Pro, and Apple says it has never sold more Macs in a fiscal year. Full-year Mac revenue came to $37.9 billion, up from $33.7 billion. Apple also set a September-quarter record for people new to the Mac.The touchscreen MacBook Pro was only introduced last week, so it is not part of these numbers. Asked whether touch means iOS and macOS are heading toward one operating system, Ternus said no fundamentally different changes are planned, and that Apple would not talk about them anyway.Not every product kept up. iPad slipped 10 percent to $6.23 billion and wearables fell 8 percent to $8.3 billion, both against tough comparisons with last year’s product releases.India set an all-time revenue record for Apple, with the Mac also hitting all-time highs there. Apple Pay recently went live in the country with Axis Bank, which Ternus cited as an example of where services can still grow.Greater China told a more mixed story. Revenue grew 21 percent to $17.54 billion, a quarterly record, but that was about $1 billion short of what analysts had estimated. Parekh said supply constraints played a part.So Ternus walks into the holiday quarter with record sales behind him and memory costs ahead. Apple expects December to be its biggest quarter ever, with revenue up 7 to 10 percent, but higher chip prices will trim gross margin to 45 to 46 percent, and Mac, iPad and iPhone Duo supply will stay tight while demand runs ahead.
Article Summary: Apple set September-quarter records for people upgrading their iPhones in the US, mainland China and India. Apple closed fiscal 2026 with record revenue of $478.8 billion, up 15 percent, and earnings per share of $8.98. Apple expects gross margin of 45 to 46 percent, down from 47.9 percent.

Why is America facing a monkey shortage

Why are monkeys important for pharmaceutical research

America's pharmaceutical industry is facing a lab monkey crisis because of AI. A TechCrunch report says that the rising costs and restrictions on imports are adding pressure on laboratories. China has played a major role in supplying laboratory monkeys to the US. China, as stated in the report, accounted for nearly 60% of America's laboratory monkey imports before it banned exports in 2020. Facing supply constraints, American laboratories subsequently turned to Cambodia. However, a 2022 investigation found that wild-caught monkeys were falsely represented as captive-bred animals. Now, a startup backed by Palantir cofounder Joe Lonsdale plans to establish a large-scale monkey breeding facility in the US to help address the problem.As stated in the report, Safer Human Medicine, said to be backed by Joe Lonsdale aims to eventually breed 30,000 macaques over the next twenty years. The proposed facility is intended to reduce American laboratories' dependence on imported monkeys, which are widely used in pharmaceutical research and testing.The shortage has become more pressing as AI helps researchers discover potential drugs faster, increasing the number of experimental treatments that may need to be tested.However, the supply problem existed even before the recent growth of AI-assisted drug discovery.As mentioned above, China was one of the key suppliers of laboratory monkeys to the US. Since the export ban in 2020, the pharmaceutical industry has been hit with shortages. This in turn has also added to the cost.As stated in the report, macaques reportedly cost around $3,000 in 2019. But today their prices have since climbed to more than $20,000 with China reportedly charging approximately $26,000 per macaque.According to estimates, US laboratories import around 20,000 monkeys every year. Macaques are commonly used in medical experiments because of their biological similarities to humans. Researchers use them to study the safety, toxicity and biological effects of potential treatments before they move into human clinical trials.AI is also changing the drug discovery process. Researchers can use AI tools to identify potential medicines and generate more drug candidates in less time. However, promising candidates may still require laboratory studies, including animal testing, before human trials can begin.
